title: An electric car, layer by layer
description: Select a component in the model or use the labelled buttons. The separated positions are an explanatory exploded view, not an assembly procedure.

objects.label: Body and cabin
objects.description: The outer shell defines the silhouette and encloses the cabin. This schematic omits detailed crash structures and interior trim.

objects.label: Chassis and axles
objects.description: The frame supports the main assemblies. Axles are simplified here; real suspension and steering linkages contain many more parts.

objects.label: Traction battery
objects.description: Stores electrical energy for propulsion. Here the flat pack sits between the axles, below the cabin.

objects.label: Motor and reduction gear
objects.description: The electric motor produces torque. A reduction gear passes that torque to the driven wheels; this example illustrates rear-wheel drive.

objects.label: Power electronics
objects.description: Controls electrical power delivered to the traction motor. The orange cable indicates the electrical connection, not a wiring specification.

objects.label: Wheels and tyres
objects.description: Tyres are the contact between the vehicle and road. The geometry shows wheel, rim and hub depth; the brakes and suspension are schematic.

poster.alt: Exploded car: green body above a gold battery, grey chassis and wheels, with blue motor and orange power electronics separated to the rear.
